description: This file defines a React functional component named MainLayout which provides a layout structure with a header, a collapsible sidebar, and a content area. It manages the sidebar open/close state based on user interaction and screen size, and listens for a custom event 'toggle-sidebar' to toggle the sidebar visibility.
